name: BrainBox
author: Arial-Bold
description_short: An AI-powered hologram chatbot for GameCube. Ask it anything!
description_long: Your friendly holographic professor who lives right inside your GameCube! Ask him anything using a GameCube Microphone or PSO keyboard, and he'll answer aloud in it's own voice. BrainBox brings your GameCube to life with an animated 3D professor, on-console text-to-speech, and AI integration supporting Groq, Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT with your own API key. Additional features include live speech captions, built-in updates, and customizable display settings.
